CREATE TABLE general_food ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, dictionary_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE, protein NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fat NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, carbs NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, callories NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT fk_general_food_dictionary_item FOREIGN KEY (dictionary_item_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_general_food_dictionary_item ON general_food (dictionary_item_id);
